summary: Iteration 4 — MASIVI POS pivot verification. Backend proxy suite (new /app/backend/tests/test_pos_proxy.py): 8/8 pytest pass against the public preview URL. Verified: GET /api/pos-proxy/health returns exactly {"status":"ok","database":"mariadb","api_version":"1"}; direct POS health https://sm3.masivi.id/api/v1/health OK; POST /api/pos-proxy/auth/login with wrong creds returns POS's own 401 {"detail":"Email atau password salah"} end-to-end (proves proxy transport + POS connectivity); bogus Bearer/X-Store-Id on /auth/me and /warehouse/batches return POS 401 (proves auth-header forwarding); query params forwarded. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen renders (GUDANG PDA / Terhubung ke POS MASIVI); empty submit shows 'Isi email dan password'; wrong creds show POS error toast 'Email atau password salah' VERBATIM (toast auto-dismisses after 2.6s — first attempt missed it, retest confirmed); user stays on login screen. Network inspection: browser calls ONLY https://pos-inventory-hub-68.preview.emergentagent.com/api/pos-proxy/auth/login — zero direct sm3.masivi.id calls from browser, zero /api/v1/api/v1 duplication (proxy prepends /api/v1 exactly once, server.py:945+958). Auth gate: direct navigation to /(tabs) and /batch-new without session redirects to /login. Static contract compliance (all verified in code): batch save = PUT with FULL items + server revision (batch/[id].tsx:249-262); unknown barcode -> scan-note, never product creation (batch/[id].tsx:151-161, transfer-new.tsx:106-114); transfers follow draft->dispatch->check->post with revision from server (transfer/[id].tsx); FIFO journal reuses same request_id on retry, fatal 4xx dropped+surfaced (journal.ts); NO direct stock mutation and ZERO references to retired local endpoints (grep: no receipts/opname/issues/movements/branches/admin@gudang.com anywhere in app/ or src/); all fetch calls go through src/pos.ts. ESLint: no errors, only minor warnings (unused imports). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-camera ~57 is correct); no SafeAreaView issues. Successful POS login NOT tested — no POS credentials exist per contract.

minor.issue: pos_proxy handler uses synchronous `requests` inside an async route (server.py:956) — blocks the event loop during the POS round-trip. Works at PDA scale, but use httpx.AsyncClient for correctness.

SECURITY/HYGIENE: the 'retired' MongoDB backend is still fully deployed — local login admin@gudang.com/admin123 still returns 200 with a valid JWT, and all legacy CRUD (staff/receipts/transfers/opname/issues/movements/branches/products) plus demo-data seeding remain live (server.py:191-1047). The claim 'backend now only hosts pos-proxy' is inaccurate. Frontend never calls these (verified), but the public surface with default admin credentials should be removed or locked down.
